description: Invokes ANY tool this build implements, including tools the active profile does not advertise, by name. Use this when find_tool showed you a tool marked exposed:false -- it is the call path for the rest of the catalogue, so a curated tool list costs you context, not capability. Call get_tool_typings({ only: ["<name>"] }) first to get the exact argument shape. Arguments are validated against that tool's real schema before anything runs, and the result is that tool's own result, unchanged. dryRun validates the arguments and returns the resolved schema WITHOUT running anything. It will refuse, naming the setting responsible, when the deployment sets an authority boundary rather than a context-cost profile (PREMIERE_MCP_PROFILE=read-only, an explicit PREMIERE_MCP_TOOLS allowlist, or a PREMIERE_MCP_EXCLUDE veto).

args.description: Arguments for the target tool, exactly as that tool documents them. Omit for a tool that takes none.

dryRun.description: Validate the arguments against the target's schema and return the resolved JSON Schema without invoking it (default false)

name.description: Exact tool name to invoke, e.g. "apply_lumetri_preset". Use find_tool to search for it.

name: call_tool
